balls.text: gives him room by moving outside leg stump and swings the full length delivery to the square-leg boundary ... His maiden IPL 50 as well.
full in length, can't get much power behind that shot, gets across for a single after pushing it to cover
full pitched, square driven for a single
banged in short of length, moves away from the leg stump and carves it to the cover boundary. Slap!
high bouncer and the batsman can't reach it .. Wide
moves outside leg and flat-bats it between cover and mid-off
clears the front foot and slams it to deep cover
pulls the final delivery to deep midwicket
moves down the track to play a lovely inside-out lofted hit to extra-cover boundary
heaves this one to long-on
lands around off and breaks away, goes for the sweep but can't connect
swats this one away for a single
forces this one to deep point for a single
drags it short and Abhishek clears the front foot and pulls it to wide midwicket boundary. Crash!
charges out but doesn't connect with the slog
Pacy bouncer and a shout for a catch. The batsman went for the pull, seemed beaten for pace and DK took it and appealed for a catch.
Mascarenhas is run out. It was pushed to third man and he came back for the second run but he is not even in the frame when DK breaks the stumps.
around off stump, pushed to cover point
really full, just short of the blockhole, pushed out to cover
gets forward to drive through covers
around off stump line, carved to right of backward point for a quick single
Dogra is run out It was cut to point. Dogra did all the running there. first he ran nearly all the way to the other end and came back. Too late. Gone!
front-of-the hand slider, quick and on the middle and leg, tapped towards midwicket  .. he comes back for the second and  dives to get back inside the crease.
full and quicker, swung past square-leg
The time out chat is showing results. Dogra moves down the track and heaves this one over long-on!
another flighted delivery around off stump and lofted to deep cover
Ladda, who has been generally been pushing it through quick, slows this one and flights it across and the batsman charged down the track to lift it over long-on
quicker on the middle, worked through midwicket
straightens on the off and middle line, cut away off the back foot
moves outside leg, Sangwan hurls it full on the leg and middle, square driven for a single
the slow yorker attempted outside off stump, the batsman tries to steer it to third man but no wood on leather
high bouncer around leg stump line. Wide
moves outside leg stump and carves a length delivery from the off stump line past the diving Dilshan at backward point
bouncer flies across the batsman who watches it sail by ...
slower one on the stumps, swatted to midwicket for a quick single
yorker length on the leg stump line, goes off the boot and Karthik makes a good diving stop
googly from outside off, chopped wide of backward point
another slider on the middle stump line, this time worked through midwicket
the quick slider on the middle stump line, stays outside the line, picks it off the pitch to jab it to cover
leans forward to drive through covers
from wide of the crease, slider on the off stump, pushed back to the bowler
full pitched around off stump, driven to right of sweeper cover
Another slower one, fuller this time around off, driven down to long-off
just outside off stump, slower one, pushed out to point
banged in short on the leg stump line, goes past the attempted pull to the keeper
slower one on the middle stump line, wristed just past square-leg and they run hard to come back for the second run
leans forward to drive to cover
Googly .. breaks back in from outside off stump .. Dogra is hit on the pad, trying to defend. Loud shout for lbw .. did it strike him outside off? Looked a good shout .. Perhaps on the off stump line
Flamboyant hit over extra cover. Really skilful. It was flighted legbreak around off  stump and Dogra went down on his knee to drive it inside-out up and over the boundary
slider around off stump, tapped to backward point
worked through the on side for a signle
stays back to pull it to wide long-on
leans forward to drive through the field
lands it on a length, cuts across outside off stump, Dogra opens the bat face to steer it wide of a tumbling Nannes at third man .. He could have stopped it but ends up palming it beyond the ropes
length delivery moving across the batsman, guided to point
pushes this across Jhbujhunwala who square drives it very neatly , good timing and all that, but hits it straight to Sehwag at deep point region
on a length, straightening .. dabbed away ..
flatter, quicker, slider on the middle stump line, just pushed away .. another tight over from Ladda
slow this one, tosses it up, really full, square driven to deep cover
fuller, on the off stump line, trying to land it on the blockhole, driven to long-off
straightens around off, punched to the off side
around the off stump, again skids in - that has been mostly what Ladda has been doing so far - pushed out to cover
on the off stump line, punched down to long-on
turns this to wide of midwicket for a single
kicks up from short of length around off, run down to third man
fiery bouncer on the middle stump line but it climbs above the batsman .. wide
hit to sweeper cover for a single
length delivery on the middle stump line, pushed out to the off side
length delivery on the middle stump line, jabbed away to the off side

Sangwan has bowled well at Smith so far and takes him out now. Smith charged out for the big hit but the youngster banged it shorter and Smith mistimes the pull shot towards deep midwicket. Sehwag runs in and almost clangs it! The ball pops out of his palm ... once .. twice and he takes it on the third attempt!
quicker one just outside off, skids on straight, cut straight to point.
slower, around off stump line, pushed out to cover
pushes this one down the leg side. Ladda jumps before he gets into the final stride pre release
quick slider around off, tapped to backward point
gets forward to defend to the on side
shout for lbw. Not given. Why I wouldn't know. It landed on middle and straightened, the batsman was trying the paddle sweep and got struck right in front of middle.
leans forward to defend the slider
jumps out, Sangwan shortens the length, worked to midwicket
lovely length delivery shaping away ever so late from Smith who is comprehensively beaten, trying to defend
bounces across Jhunjhunwala who dabs it to third man
short in length around off and middle line, mistimes the pull shot to wards mid-on
full in length and outside off stump, the batsman pushes at it and is beaten
short in length, cuts in towards middle and leg, clipped to fine-leg for a single
length delivery cutting away from Smith who edges it to third man

Done in by the slower one. It was almost predictable that Yusuf, who was dead-batting so far, would go after this ball. He picked the wrong ball, though. He didn't pick the slower one all that well and ended up dragging it straight up and AB moved to his right at mid-on to collect it.
back of length and on the off stump line, again Yusuf continues to remain cautious and pushes it back to Maharoof
full in length, slower one on the middle but Yusuf taps it gently back down the pitch
length delivery around off stump line, Yusuf gets behind the line to tap it back to the bowler
length delivery pushed across outside off stump, Smith edges the off drive to square-leg
leans forward to defend .. big cheers from the crowd as Yusuf Pathan walked out to the middle.

Oh boy! what a comeback from Mishy! Done in by the googly! It broke back in from just outside off stump, Ojha went for the big cover drive. Mistake. He went outside the line of the ball and lost his stumps. Mishra is almost angry as he celebrates!
Bosh! Mishy overpitches the flighted delivery and Ojha clears the front foot and swings it cleanly .. high and over long-on
flighted leg break around off stump, Ojha stretches forward to sweep it to the square-leg boundary. Thump!
slower, slightly shorter, turns away from the off stump, Ojha stays back to cut it hard past point
flat, straight, on a length on the middle, skids on to middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler
fuller, around off stump, SMith is rooted to the crease and mistimes the off drive .. the ball rolls away to mid-off
And again. It kicks up from short of length around off stump, pushed out towards point
Much better. Gets to the line he was troubling the batsmen before. He hits the deck short of length and cuts the back in to the middle and off line, defended back down the pitch
Again tries a short delivery but too short and moving on the leg and middle line, Smith pulls it hard to the square-leg boundary
bangs it in short outside off, Smith swivels to pull it past square-leg
Nannes continues to hit the deck hard and is troubling the batsmen. This one is outside off stump and Smith is beaten, trying to punch on the up
full pitched on the off stump line, pushed out to left of mid-off for a single.
straightens outside off stump, run down to Nannes at third man
Edged over the lone slip fielder. It was a slower one, full and just outside off, Ojha tried to slog it across the line over midwicket but gets a lucky fat edge
length delivery around off stump, guided to backward point
Wallop. Every time Maharoof has hurled it fuller, he has paid for it. This one is not overpitched but it was fuller in length and Ojha thrashes it over mid-on
hits the deck on a length, around the off stump, pushed out to cover
Superb over this. Nannes hurls this fuller, and takes it away from Ojha who stabs it just short of the lunging second slip fielder who makes a half-stop
Another fine bouncer, Ojha allows it to fly past his face
a nasty lifter , just above chest-high and Ojha tries to play it down initially before he tries to get his bat out of the way and the ball crashes into the right shoulder
around the off stump line, tapped to the off side
Swallowed by Dilshan at backward point. It was a length delivery moving away from him and Swapnil hit it on the up, pretty powerfully, but Dilshan lunged forward to take a neat catch.
slants it across Swapnil who chases it but doesn't connect

back of length on the middle and leg, Smith clips it away forcefully to the square-leg boundary. Dirk Nannes gets a bad bouncel and lets the ball slip through his fingers to turn a single to a fourWhat a start for the Royals.
pushes it across.. too far across outside off
leans forward to defend the length delivery
good delivery this time, on a length, cutting away from Smith who is beaten, pushing inside the line
commits the mistake he did in the first ball  - overpitches it and Smith whips it through the on side
Immediately, Maharoof corrects the length, hits the deck on a length, it kicks up, Swapnil takes the bottom-hand off the handle as he fends it behind square-leg
Four first ball. Over pitched outside off stump and Swapnil leans across to square drive to the point boundary
flighted off break around off stump line, slog swept to deep midwicket region ...And that's it the Daredevils have won by six wickets.
goes for the yorker, on the leg stump line, runs off the pad
slow loopy delivery outside off, run down to third man
the slow bouncer this time .. Karthik sways away and the ball bounces once before it reaches the keeper
third slower one in a row .. run down to third man
another slower one, well wide outside off, DK reaches out to cut it for a single
slower one outside off, DK waits and waits before slapping it to left of backward point
full in length, eased towards mid-on for a quick single .. DK dives to get inside the crease. just 10 more
full again, driven to the off side, can't pierce the field.
leans forward to drive another full delivery to mid-off
Swing and a miss. DK wants to deposit the full delivery over mid-on but fails to connect
shrot in length, bottom edge on the cut shot and the ball bounces to  the keeper

Full delivery, driven back down the track... richochets of the non-striker's batand goes towards the bowler who then fires a direct hit at the striker's end! DK just about manages to get back inside the crease!
tosses it up really high and loops it outside off, DK stretches forward to play a neat-looking off drive to left of long-off
gets forward to defend
quicker slider outside off, chopped down to backward point where Munna bhai , Munaf Patel ie, makes a complete mess of a regulation stop. Warne looks pissed.
full delivery on the leg stump line, nudged away
similar delivery and Manhas takes the aerial route, more bottom hand, and hits to sweeper cover
flighted legbreak on off and middle, Karthik drives with the turn to deep cover
jumps from short of length, rolls off the thigh pad
Another lemon cut! Length delivery, not yorker, outside off and DK inside edges the intended cover drive to fine-leg where Yusuf makes a diving stop
kicks up from short of length, jabbed away off the back foot
yorker length outside off stump, the batsman tries to dig it out and gets a nice little inside edge past the stumps and to fine-leg region
outside off stump, run down to third man
Another Tait wide. Warne, keeper and the bowler appeal .. Old trick. Doesn't work.
hangs on the back foot to push it wide of midwicket
leans forward to defend

turns in from outside leg , tapped to right of short midwicket .. confusion between the two batsmen. DK is sent back and he dives to get back into the crease .. the throw misses the stumps and they then cross over for the single
leans forward to defend to cover

Warney removes AB! Loopy delivery outside off stump, AB, who has been playing quietly, nudging and pushing his way around, suddenly decides to go for the expansive inside-out cover drive. Caught at short cover!
on the middle and off line, slip in place, tapped towards point for a single
flighted leg break on the leg stump line, squeezed back down the pitch
back of length, cut to right of point where Swapnil makes a diving half-stop to prevent the single ..
slower one, on the leg stump line, worked to midwicket
full pitched on the leg and middle line, flicked to deep midwicket
short in length, pushed wider outside off, run down to third man
skips down the track and plays a neat whippy on-the-up drive through midwicket.
backs away outside leg, waits for the ball to arrive before cutting it to sweeper cover
leg break slightly short in length outside off, cut to deep point
flighted loopy delivery on the middle stump line, eased to sweeper cover
moves down the track and on drives to deep midwicket
turns from the leg stump line, AB goes back to punch it wide of long-on
turns from outside leg, turned past square-leg

Smith takes a very good catch to remove the big fish. Sehwag got too much under the ball as he went for another big swing towards long-on and skied it to midwicket. Smith was running in circles as the ball swerved down but he lunged out at the last minute to take a neat catch under pressure. The fun is over folks. Sehwag is back in the hut.
Bang! Sehwag has thrashed this full delivery over long-on where it has been sucked over by the delighted fans
leans forward to drive to mid-on region
leans forward to push it to the off side of the pitch
pushes it well outside off stump, cut to right of sweeper cover for couple of runs
in the zone outside off stump and the keeper collects
stays back to punch this leg break to long-on
goes well back inside the crease to force this one to long-on
slows up the pace ... flights it on the middle and leg, defended carefully
Whack! He backs away outside leg, opens-up his stance and pulls the short-of-length delivery to wide long-on boundary
flighted around leg stump line, flicked past square-leg
backs away to cut it hard to sweeper cover
leans forward to tap it to the on side
goes for the big hit to the on side but ends up dragging it off the inner half of the bat to deep midwicket
length delivery on the off and middle, punched back to the bowler
back of length outside off, Sehwag taps it to midwicket .. vacant spaces there ,.. and comes back for two runs!
Big swing and a miss. The keeper takes out the bails. Sehwag was in,
gets forward to ease it through extra cover. Sehwag back on strike.
another slower one, loopy delivery outside off, driven to Warne at extra cover.
full in length on the off and middle line, AB hands the strike back to Sewhag with a drive to long-off
gets forward to drill this one along the ground to long-off
More violence. Crash Bang Wallop. He cleared the front foot and simply swung through the line of a length delivery to the straight boundary
Aaha! Style and substance. 50 up. This one was banged in short from round the stumps, Sehwag arched back, made his own room and upper cut it to third man boundary!
Thunderous wallop. Sehwag rushed down the track, lunged forward to reach the slower one and sends it crashing over wide long-off boundary
almost run out. It was driven down the track and AB had backed up too far .. Mascarenhas tries to field and almost deflects it, unintentionally, on to the stumps at the non-striker's end
leans forward to defend to the off side

Dropped by Tait Sehwag goes for the big swing across the line and top edges it behind short fineleg.. Tait turned back and ran in circle .. and just about got his fingers on it. He didn't judge it well. What a huge moment.
Immense fun. He opens the bat-face this time and slices the length delivery over point.
Whadaaplayaaaa! It was a length delivery around off stump, Sehwag went forward and smoked through the line .. up and over long-off. Superbly hit.
full length delivery, driven to cover
short in length, tilting in slighty just outside off stump, defended to the on side
back of length outside off stump, steered to backward point
stays back, stays beside the line of the slightly slower delivery and chops it to third man
length delivery on the middle, defended to the on side
full in length, eased past the bowler
gets it straight this time and AB pushes out at it and his bat is broken! That was a nearly a yorker and AB made contact with the bottom of the bat. A piece of wood goes flying. Change of bats
Yet another wide. Tait screams out a four-letter word and then smiles as he walks back. Love is a four letter word too ..
Another Tait wide. No one would be surprised. Tait smiles as he passes the umpire.
gets forward to drive the length delivery to sweeper cover
slip, short cover and short midwicket in for the hat-trick ball... AB leans forward to defend it down the pitch
Dilshan gone for a first-ball duck. It was a length delivery that straightened outside off, Dilshan pushed inside the line and got a thin nick. Hmmm... And here we go ..twist twist

length delivery around off stump line, Gambhir wants to heave that one over mid-on but fails. He cleared the front foot, opened-up his stance but couldn't get much power behind the pull.. the ball lobs up to mid-on
length delivery outside off stump, stays back to cut it past cover for couple of runs
leans forward to push it to the off side
around the off stump, run down to third man
Much fun. From both batsmen. Gambhir charges out to carve the length delivery one bounce over cover boundary
slower one, straightening on the off stump line, Sehwag checks his drive and squeezes it to point
Crashed! Length delivery on the off and middle stump line, Sehwag cleared the front foot and knifed it on the up between the bowler and mid-on
Thrashed! Full pitched outside off stump and Sehwag wallops it over long-off.
another one kicking up from back of length, flashed away to backward point .. half-stop .. single
pacy short-of-length delivery just outside off stump, Sehwag leaned back to carve it past the diving backward point fielder

the yorker arrives,,, Sehwag digs it out to the off side .. Gambhir sets off for a run and gets back .. Tait picks the ball and fires in a direct hit at the non-striker's end and it ricochets off the stumps to the boundary!
full in length outside off stump, square driven to point
short in length, cutting away from the off stump, run down to third man
driven down the track and the bowler lunges to stop it
pacy delivery, almost 150 kmph, down the leg side .. bye .. THe keeper had collected it cleanly but he was so far back that Gambhir rushes across for the run!
cuts in, gets past the attempted on-the-up hit
Wallop. He clears the front foot and whacks the length delivery over mid-on
moves in to middle and leg, from the length, Sehwag swings it to the left of the diving backward square-leg fielder
the keeper is standing up to the stumps now. This one has been turned to backward square-leg
leans forward to whip the length delivery and mistimes it uppishly past square-leg
walks down the track first ball and eases the full length delivery to deep cover
